title_en: Jurisprudence of Women (Lesson 117) - Does the Ahl al-Bayt in the Verse of Purification Include the Prophet's Wives (peace be upon him and his family)?
summary: In this lesson, Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari examines the Verse of Purification (Ayat al-Tathir) and addresses the theological and jurisprudential question of whether the Prophet's wives are included in the Ahl al-Bayt.
